sentences.text: The F.I.R. of the matter has been lodged on 10.3.2021, under Sections 498A, 304B IPC and 3/4 D.P. Act by Narayan against the applicant and four other accused persons alleging therein that his daughter was married with the applicant on 21.4.2019.
At the time of marriage a Splendor motorcycle was purchased but the father-in-law Ram Sajeevan during Tilak objected to it and the same was returned and then an Apache motorcycle was given.
There was a demand of Rs.1 lakh as dowry from the deceased.
On 10.3.2021 the deceased was tortured and assaulted who informed her parents, after which they reached at the place of occurrence found the deceased hanging from fan.
The F.I.R. has thus been lodged.
5. Learned counsel for the applicant argued that the applicant has been falsely implicated in the present case.

It is argued that the present case is a case of suicide which is suggestive from the post mortem report wherein the deceased has been found to have received a single ligature mark on her body and cause of death has been opined as asphyxia as a result of ante mortem hanging.
It is argued while placing para-13 of the affidavit that the deceased was a short tempered lady and she committed suicide as she was depressed.
It is argued that the applicant has never demanded any dowry.
It is argued that the applicant is having no criminal history as stated in para-24 of the affidavit and is in jail since 11.3.2021.
6. Per contra, learned AGA opposed the prayer for bail and argued that the applicant is husband and there are allegations against him.
The deceased died in her matrimonial house within seven years of marriage.
The death is unnatural.
7. After having heard learned counsels for the parties and perusing the records, it is evident that the applicant is husband of the deceased.
The deceased died an unnatural death within 7 years of marriage.
There is no credible reason given by the applicant as to why the deceased committed suicide in her matrimonial house.
8. Looking into the facts and circumstances of the case as well as nature and gravity of the offence, I am not inclined to release the applicant on bail.
9. The bail application is, accordingly, rejected.

(Samit Gopal,J.) Order Date :- 18.9.2023 Naresh  Jitendra Yadav vs State Of U.P. on 18 September, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/36425002/
